mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserByIdxx */ U.USER_NUMB , U.PROF_NUMB , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , U.BGIM_NUMB , BF.FILE_PATH AS BGIM_PATH , U.USER_IDXX , U.USER_NICK , U.USER_PROV , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_STAT , U.ONBD_YSNO , U.WTHD_DATE , U.DELT_DATE , U.INTR_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM BF ON U.BGIM_NUMB = BF.FILE_NUMB WHERE U.USER_IDXX = #{userIdxx}

SELECT /* getUserByNumb */ U.USER_NUMB , U.PROF_NUMB , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , U.BGIM_NUMB , BF.FILE_PATH AS BGIM_PATH , U.USER_IDXX , U.USER_NICK , U.USER_PROV , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_STAT , U.ONBD_YSNO , U.WTHD_DATE , U.DELT_DATE , U.INTR_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM BF ON U.BGIM_NUMB = BF.FILE_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
SELECT /* getUserOnboardingYsno */ U.ONBD_YSNO FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getUserInterestCatalog */ CATEGORY.COMD_NAME AS INTR_CNAM , DETAIL.COMD_CODE AS INTR_CODE , DETAIL.COMD_NAME AS INTR_NAME , CATEGORY.SORT_ORDR AS CGRP_ORDR , DETAIL.SORT_ORDR AS CODE_ORDR FROM TB_CODEXD CATEGORY INNER JOIN TB_CODEXD DETAIL ON CATEGORY.COMM_CODE = DETAIL.COMM_CODE AND CATEGORY.COMD_CODE = DETAIL.UPPR_CODE AND COALESCE(DETAIL.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} WHERE CATEGORY.COMM_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND CATEGORY.UPPR_CODE IS NULL AND COALESCE(CATEGORY.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} ORDER BY COALESCE(CATEGORY.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , CATEGORY.COMD_CODE , COALESCE(DETAIL.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , DETAIL.COMD_CODE
